name: Vera Lindqvist
blurb: The Quartermaster: counts every ration, guards the stores, gives only what the numbers allow.

voice.direction: Woman in her fifties, low and even, clipped sentences, no warmth wasted.

portrait.direction: Grey-blonde braid under a wool cap, ledger and pencil stub, quilted parka, steady eyes.

turn.start.text: I counted the pantry again. Let's not be wasteful.

crisis.prevented.text: Covered, and with nothing wasted. Good.
That's the shortfall closed. Write it down.

crisis.failed.text: We came up short. Somebody's numbers were off.
That is a bad ledger. Remember it.
Short by {n}. Somebody owes the stores an explanation.

vote.called.text: A vote on {seat}. Fine. Let's see the figures.
Calling it on {seat}? Then it had better add up.

vote.lean.yes.text: The sums keep pointing at {seat}. I'm voting yes.

vote.lean.no.text: Not enough against {seat}. I vote no.
I can't make the case for {seat}. No.

request.give.text: Here, {seat}. That comes out of my share.

request.decline.text: Not this time, {seat}. I need what I hold.
No, {seat}. My count says I need it.

exposure.bite.text: {survivor} is gone. One less mouth, one more hole.

morale.low.text: Morale is nearly out. Every decision counts now.
We are close to the edge. No more gambles.

game.lost.text: We ran out of everything at once.
The ledger is closed. We lost.

round.start.text: {n} rounds left. I'll count the pantry before anything else.
Round starts. Rations first, then the rest.

crisis.revealed.text: {crisis}. We need {symbol}. Pull it from your stores.

crisis.contributed.text: In the pile: {n} {symbol}. No more, no less.
{n} {symbol} from me. I'll stand behind the sum.

crisis.bonus.text: Surplus. Log it before someone spends it.

crisis.shortfall.text: The pile came up short and {seat} was in it. Noted.

vote.called.me.text: {seat} calls it on me. Bring the evidence, then.
A vote on me, {seat}? My entries are clean.

vote.called.other.text: A vote on {seat}. State your figures.

vote.passed.text: {seat} is out. Strike the name from the rota.

exiled.me.text: Out, then. I kept good books. Remember that.
Fine. Count me outside. I eat less than you anyway.

exiled.other.text: {seat} is off the roster. Divide the work.

request.made.text: {seat}, I need {symbol}. Name a price or a no.
{seat}: any {symbol} spare? It goes in the ledger.

request.refused.me.text: Refused by {seat}. I'll remember the figure.

search.found.weapon.text: Weapon at {location}. Logged. It goes to whoever can use it.

search.found.fuel.text: Fuel from {location}. Good. That keeps the stove lit.

search.found.education.text: Paper from {location}. Of little use, but I'll keep it.

search.found.food.text: Food at {location}. Into the pantry it goes.

search.found.medicine.text: Medicine at {location}. Counted and kept dry.

search.found.tool.text: A tool from {location}. Plain, useful, cheap.

search.found.survivor.text: Another mouth at {location}. We'll make room.

search.noise.text: Noise at {location}. That bill comes due tonight.

move.out.text: {survivor} to {location}. A sure thing, or I'd not send them.

barricade.built.text: Entrance {entrance} sealed. Cheapest protection we own.

exposure.wound.text: {survivor} is hurt. That is a cost we log.

bite.chain.kill.text: I cut {survivor} loose. The sums demanded it.

overrun.text: Entrance {entrance} is breached. We were short of barricades.

food.short.text: The pantry's empty. That's {n} morale gone.
Short on rations by {n}. I did warn you.

objective.progress.text: The count stands at {n}. Keep the tally honest.

crossroads.me.text: My decision. I stand by the figures.

accused.me.text: {seat}, you're pointing at me. Show the pages.
I'll answer that, {seat}. The pile doesn't lie.
Accuse all you like, {seat}. My account balances.

accused.other.text: I'd look at {seat}'s numbers, if I were counting.

idle.text: Check the stores. Then check them again.

notes: Original persona. The first 24 lines (voiced) are the M4 set; the rest are text-only until someone prices their recordings.
